page.layout: One page of text, single column; page number top right; woodcut ornament band above the title block; no margin notes; signature mark "A.j." at the foot right of the last line.

main_text.head: AD LIBELLVM AB ANONYMO QVODAM RECENS AEDITUM, hoc titulo.
DE EXTERNA SEU visibili Dei Ecclesia, vbi illa reperiri possit, & quænam vera sit, &c. seu potius, aduersus Externam & visibilem Ecclesiam.
LAMB. DANÆI PRO EXTERNA SEV VISIBILI ECCLESIA, necessaria Responsio.
main_text.p: ANTEQVAM, viri fratres mihi in Christo charissimi, ad illum librum respondeam, quem ad me misistis (Dominū Deum precatus vt ipsius gloriæ, atque Ecclesiæ Dei sit magna ipsius misericordia, vtilis hic labor meus) de re ipsa, de qua futura est disputatio, paucis dicam; vt responsiones nostræ ad proposita argumenta facilius intelligi, & veritas ipsa (quam ipsius libri scriptor, quantum potuit, ipsissimis tenebris inuoluere

page.notes: Woodcut initial "A" of "ANTEQVAM" is a decorative ornamental letter. The signature "A.j." is a gathering mark. Two dingbat or pilcrow-like marks appear at the right of the heading line "LAMB. DANÆI" and are not transcribed. Line "respondeam" may read "respondeam" with a faint mark; "proposita" contains a possible Cyrillic-looking letter rendering and should be checked against the scan.
